seed_desc_oil_change: Oil loses its lubricating properties with mileage and time. Regular changes protect the engine from premature wear.
seed_desc_oil_filter: The oil filter traps particles and contaminants. If saturated, oil circulates unfiltered and accelerates engine wear.
seed_desc_air_filter: A dirty air filter reduces power, increases consumption, and can damage intake sensors.
seed_desc_brake_pads: Friction compound wears with use. Below 3mm thickness, braking distance increases dangerously.
seed_desc_tires: Tires degrade both by mileage and age. Incorrect pressure or uneven wear compromises grip and safety.
seed_desc_spark_plugs: Worn spark plugs increase consumption, make starting difficult, and can damage the ignition coil.
seed_desc_timing_belt: The timing belt is critical: if it breaks, the engine suffers severe damage. It must be changed at the manufacturer's interval without exception.
seed_desc_brake_fluid: Brake fluid is hygroscopic: it absorbs moisture, reducing its boiling point and braking effectiveness.
seed_desc_coolant: Coolant loses its antifreeze and anticorrosive properties over time, potentially damaging the engine's internal circuit.
seed_desc_battery_cooling: The battery cooling system is vital for maintaining optimal temperature and prolonging cell life.
seed_desc_cabin_filter: The cabin filter purifies the air entering the interior. A saturated filter reduces HVAC efficiency and can generate odors.
seed_desc_chain: The chain is the component that suffers the most wear. Regular lubrication extends its life and prevents dangerous breakage.
seed_desc_motorcycle_brake_pads: Friction compound wears with use. Below 1.5mm thickness, safety is compromised.
seed_desc_valve_adjustment: Valve adjustment maintains proper compression and prevents premature wear on the cylinder head.
seed_desc_drive_kit: Chain, sprocket, and crown wear as a set. Replacing them separately accelerates wear on the new component.
seed_desc_fork_oil: Over time it breaks down, losing density and worsening front suspension behavior.
seed_desc_battery_maintenance: Battery loses capacity with charge cycles and time. Using maintainers in winter prolongs its useful life.
seed_desc_fuel_filter: The fuel filter traps water and contaminants. A clogged filter causes power loss and hard starting.
seed_desc_egr_cleaning: Diesel peculiarity: the EGR valve accumulates soot over time. Cleaning restores engine efficiency and reduces emissions.
seed_desc_dpf_cleaning: The diesel particulate filter accumulates ash. If not regenerated properly, it may need professional cleaning or replacement.
seed_desc_glow_plugs: Glow plugs preheat the combustion chamber for cold starts. A failed plug causes misfiring and white smoke.
seed_desc_inverter_coolant: The power electronics and electric motor generate heat. Coolant prevents overheating and component failure.
seed_desc_drive_unit_oil: The reduction gear in the drive unit has its own oil. Change intervals vary by manufacturer.
seed_desc_hybrid_battery_filter: The hybrid battery has a dedicated cooling fan with an intake filter. Clean annually; replace if clogged.
seed_desc_adblue_refill: The SCR system consumes AdBlue. Refill at each service or when warning appears.
